newsitem.title: JAPAN: Seiyu to take special charges in year.
newsitem.headline: Seiyu to take special charges in year.

text.p: Seiyu Ltd said on Friday that it would inject 27.4 billion yen to support its subsidiary, Tokyo City Finance KK, and take a special charge to its earnings of the same amount in its current business year to February 28.
Separately, the supermarket operator said it would take a charge of 3.868 billion yen in the same period, partly because the appraisal of its securities holdings had lessened.
Seiyu said it would offset these losses by selling stocks in one of its subsidiaries.
